Chih Sung-tzu fill your soul.  You know now why Master Kaen stole them from
the Monastery of Chan-Sune, for with them, a Monk of Chih Sung-tzu could
easily defeat his plans.

You sense a message from Chih Sung-tzu.  Though not verbal, you
get the impression that you must return to the Grand Master as soon
as possible.
